objective: Add bounded, provenance-preserving native DR24 Lightcurves acquisition at the Observation Service and API boundary without changing the frozen v0.2.0 feature or model contracts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The existing ObservationService uses ALeRCE; DR24 payload retrieval was previously isolated in a probe.
DR24 HMJD, photometry, color coefficient, catflags and OID partition metadata require explicit handling.

expected_improvement: Add a bounded indexed DR24 objectid acquisition contract.
Expose source-native lightcurve payloads through the Observation Service and explicit API route.
Preserve OID, filter, field, readout-channel, schema and payload-hash provenance.
Keep scientific normalization blocked until source semantics are approved and validated.

reliability.before: No bounded native DR24 indexed lightcurve adapter was exposed by the Observation Service.
reliability.after: A raw-only adapter accepts at most 10 unique OIDs and rejects unindexed broad scans.

reproducibility.before: No per-OID canonical payload hash or catalog schema hash was recorded by the application path.
reproducibility.after: The adapter records per-OID payload SHA-256, catalog schema SHA-256, requested/returned/missing OIDs, and native provenance.

validation.evidence: Feature branch only; CI and source-backed runtime execution are pending.

known_risks: DR24-to-ALeRCE photometric equivalence is not established.
Production catflags policy is not approved.
No general cross-OID identity rule is implemented.

findings: Raw DR24 acquisition can be implemented without changing the frozen v0.2.0 feature contract.
The raw source adapter must not imply that HMJD is MJD or that raw DR24 measurements are inference-ready.

open_blockers: The DR24 adapter has not been source-backed through the production environment.
No normalized DR24-to-feature-to-inference path is implemented.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep raw DR24 acquisition separate from normalized model observations until time, photometry, quality and identity contracts pass scientific validation.
Never silently substitute ALeRCE when DR24 acquisition fails.
IRSA documents ZTF object IDs as per-filter/field/quadrant identities; one astrophysical source may have multiple OIDs. Keep raw OIDs separate until AOIC cross-match is implemented and validated.
The versioned API contract in docs/api/API_V1.md now documents the raw DR24 endpoint, optional extra, request bounds, source-native response fields, error codes, and scientific/identity limitations.

The v2.1 handbook now includes a dated 2026-11-04 section for the DR24 raw endpoint, its source semantics and identity boundary, current acceptance blockers, CPVS membership status, and baseline/release controls.

The current handbook records that all 11602 CPVS candidate-only objects have a finite positive common Per value; missing common period does not explain the discrepancy. Table 2 Ng/Nr counts also require reconciliation with raw archive detections.
